items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. The Nvidia supplier also said it will pursue shareholder returns totalling about 100 trillion won ($75.4 billion) this year, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won, including 40 trillion won announced in August. SK Hynix also reiterated that it expects demand to continue to exceed supply through 2030.

items.author: LEE JAE-LIM
items.highlights: SK hynix’s operating profit surged more than sevenfold on year to a record 83.33 trillion won ($62.23 billion) in the third quarter, helping settle fears of an AI investment bubble and a looming memory chip glut as the chipmaker said its dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and high bandwidth memory (HBM) volumes are effectively sold out through 2029. ... The biggest takeaway from the earnings call was SK hynix's view of future demand — stretching into 2029, a year beyond the 2028 horizon that chipmakers had previously projected for the memory supply crunch. items.author: Stock Titan Editorial Team
items.highlights: The short answer. SK hynix reported record sales of 104.6 trillion won for July to September 2026. Even if you own no shares, it matters because SK hynix expects the rising cost of memory to mean fewer PCs and phones shipped.
